purpose: Give the artist one durable Not Now action for a real Song creative suggestion, beginning with later-this-Song semantics that survive relaunch within the current work Session and automatically expire when a distinct later Session begins.

lineage.outcome: The artist can tell N0TE not to surface a real suggestion again during the current Song work Session without N0TE forgetting the preference on relaunch or turning it into a permanent rejection.
lineage.capability: Durable later-this-Song suggestion deferral composed with canonical Attention and Suggestion semantics

why_now: Global reselection after PR #75 found REQ-SCOPE-097 dependency-ready and canonically explicit: Focus is already implemented, while durable Not Now remains unproven. Repository probes for Not Today, Do Not Suggest, deferral, later-this-Song, randomize and template behavior returned no current implementation, while the real suggestion semantic key prerequisite is now merged and cross-platform verified.

implementation_contract.binding: artist + Song + current Session + suggestion semantic key
implementation_contract.expiry: a distinct later Session for the same Song makes the deferred suggestion eligible again
implementation_contract.relaunch: relaunch during the same Session preserves the deferral
implementation_contract.authority: deferral changes suggestion visibility only and grants no mutation/provider/spend/publication authority
implementation_contract.selection: when generating a suggestion, skip keys deferred for the exact active Song/current Session; fail closed if every available candidate is deferred

completion_proof: a rendered real suggestion exposes one protected Not now action
Not now records explicit durable deferral in the canonical profile database without a second database or generic task model
the deferred semantic key is not returned again during the same Song Session, including after shell relaunch
a distinct later Session for the same Song automatically makes that key eligible again
deferral for one Song/session cannot suppress another Song or Artist profile
the POST path preserves exact Host, Origin, CSRF, one-shot action and active-Song/current-Suggestion binding
Not now performs no DAW/provider/network action and grants no action authority
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the exact implementation head
non_scope: never suggest again / Do Not Suggest
More Like This / Less Like This
next_selection_rule: After exact-head closure, return UX-01 to PRESERVED and globally reselect. Do not extend deferral horizons by adjacency.
